messages.python.help:
Standalone Creator (Python 3.10+, Node.js 22+, Windows).
From the extracted Creator folder:
python Start-Skin.py configure --proxy-mode direct
python Start-Skin.py
python Create-Skin.py start --session work/my-skin --state <managed-session.json> --id my-skin --name "My Skin"
Choose proxy instead of direct when needed. All runtime services are included in this package; no sibling package is required.
